text: dsh-mermaid-panel 是面向 DSH Web 的 Mermaid 图表侧栏插件。它注册右侧栏页面，从当前已渲染的对话代码块中识别 Mermaid 源码，并在独立页面绘制图表。图表卡片提供源码查看与复制，点击或选择放大可进入全屏视图，支持缩放、平移和适配窗口。源码仍保留在聊天记录中；插件不需要额外 API Key 或外部服务。

dsh-mermaid-panel adds a Mermaid page to DSH Web’s right sidebar. It previews diagrams found in rendered conversations. Users can view or copy source, then open a full-screen view to zoom, pan, or fit. Chat code stays unchanged. No API key or external service is needed.
想在 DSH 右侧栏集中查看当前对话里的 Mermaid 流程图。
How can I open conversation Mermaid diagrams in a separate DSH sidebar page?
dsh-mermaid-panel 的功能「侧栏图表预览」：扫描当前已渲染对话中的代码块，识别 Mermaid 源码并在右侧栏逐项显示渲染结果；卡片可查看和复制原始源码。
dsh-mermaid-panel 的功能「全屏查看图表」：点击预览图或放大按钮打开全屏视图，可拖动平移、滚轮缩放，并使用适配按钮调整图表以适合窗口。

dsh-mermaid-panel README · dsh-mermaid-panel：English | [中文](README.zh.md)

A DeepSeek Harness client plugin that adds a **Mermaid** page to the right Sidebar. It renders the Mermaid diagrams in the conversation you are reading, without touching the conversation itself.

> Published as `dsh-mermaid-panel`, not `dsh-mermaid`: that package name belongs to
> [MrmoLabs/dsh-mermaid](https://github.com/MrmoLabs/dsh-mermaid), which renders
> diagrams inline in the chat instead. The two do different things and can be
> installed side by side.

dsh-mermaid-panel README · What it does：- Registers one right-Sidebar page type (`mermaid`) and a guide capsule, so the empty Sidebar offers it as a door.
- Scans the rendered conversation for code blocks whose first line declares a Mermaid diagram, and renders them in the page's own React tree.
- Each card keeps the authored source one click away, plus copy.
- The card shows the diagram fitted and whole. Click the diagram, or **Enlarge**, to open the full-screen view. Zoom and pan live there, not on the card.
- Re-renders when the palette changes; the Sidebar's own docking, splitting, and per-Session tab persistence apply unchanged.

dsh-mermaid-panel README · What it does：The chat's code block is never hidden or replaced. Copying the source from the transcript, quoting it, or letting the model read it back still works, and a change to the chat's DOM costs the page its input rather than the transcript.

dsh-mermaid-panel README · What it deliberately does not do：- It does not modify DeepSeek Harness. Everything it uses is a declared public extension point: `ctx.sidebarRightTabs`, `sidebar.right.pane.tab`, and the `ctx.locale` / `ctx.slots` services.
- It does not render inline in the transcript. Replacing a chat code block in place would need a rendering seam that the product does not have, so the diagram lives in the Sidebar instead.
section: What it deliberately does not do

text: dsh-mermaid-panel README · How it finds diagrams：Mermaid's own parser is the final word: a source that fails to render shows the failure notice and its source instead of a diagram.

dsh-mermaid-panel README · Viewing：The card is a fitted preview. A wheel over the card scrolls the page. The preview does not zoom or pan, because that fought the page it sits in.

**Enlarge**, or a click on the diagram, opens the same diagram full screen. That view is a portal on `document.body`, so the Sidebar's scroll container cannot clip it. It keeps no state once the card is gone.

dsh-mermaid-panel README · Viewing：- The wheel zooms around the pointer. **−**, **+**, the percentage, **Fit**, and **Close** sit in the top bar.
- Dragging pans.
- `+` and `-` zoom from the center (`=` and `_` do the same). `0` fits the diagram to the window. `Esc` closes the view.

dsh-mermaid-panel README · Install：You need DeepSeek Harness and a profile whose Web GUI has the right Sidebar. The commands below use the `web` profile. `package.json` sets `engines.dsh` to `*`; this repository does not name a minimum release.

Client plugins reach the page at load. After installing, hard-refresh the Web GUI. A host restart does not load a new client plugin into a page that is already open.

dsh-mermaid-panel README · From the plugin market：The repository publishes a format 1 market index at

```
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Natsubrei/dsh-mermaid-panel/main/index.json
```

dsh-mermaid-panel README · From the plugin market：Add it in **Plugins → Discover → Add index**, then install **Mermaid diagrams** from the list. Discover ships off by default: switch on **Custom plugin markets** under the Plugins page's experimental list first. The index entry pins a git commit, so installation is reproducible and needs neither npm nor a token. DSH runs `git` against this repository. It does not download the release tarball.

dsh-mermaid-panel README · From the plugin market：The entry is generated, not hand-edited. `pnpm run market` reads `package.json` and the current commit and rewrites `index.json`. Run it after the commit that carries the built artifacts, then commit the index on its own. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md).

dsh-mermaid-panel README · From npm：The npm package is `dsh-mermaid-panel`. This install does not clone the git repository:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-mermaid-panel
```

That follows the `latest` dist-tag. To pin a release, append `@` and the `version` field from `package.json`.

dsh-mermaid-panel README · From the GitHub release：Each release uploads one asset named `dsh-mermaid-panel.tgz`, so this URL stays stable:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/Natsubrei/dsh-mermaid-panel/releases/latest/download/dsh-mermaid-panel.tgz
```

Release notes from 0.1.3 still show `github.com/Natsubrei/dsh-mermaid` and `dsh-mermaid.tgz`. That name is the package before 0.1.4. Use the command above.

dsh-mermaid-panel README · From a checkout：`client.js` and `client.mermaid.js` are committed. Installing this directory does not require a build. From the repository root:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add .
```

`dsh plugin` anchors a relative spec to the directory you invoked it from, so `.` is this checkout.

Build only when you change the page. The lockfile is `pnpm-lock.yaml`, and `build.mjs` imports `esbuild`:

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm run build
```

dsh-mermaid-panel README · From a checkout：`pnpm run build` runs `node build.mjs`. Install the directory again with the same `dsh plugin` command. The change loop is in [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md).

dsh-mermaid-panel README · Layout：| File | Role |
| --- | --- |
| `index.js` | Host half. Rendering is browser-only, so it contributes nothing. |
| `src/client.jsx` | The page type, its body, and the scan. Built into `client.js`. |
| `src/diagram-source.mjs` | Which sources are diagrams, their keys, and whether a scan changed. |
| `src/viewport.mjs` | Fit ratio, wheel factor, and zoom. |
| `src/render-policy.mjs` | Streaming keep rule and the one-at-a-time render queue. |
| `client.mermaid.js` | The Mermaid engine as a lazy loader chunk, requested on the first diagram. |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | Inserts the plugin into the profile. |
| `locale/en.json`, `locale/zh.json` | Plugin-inventory title and description. |
| `index.json` | The market index this repository publishes; generated by `scripts/market-index.mjs`. |
| `scripts/market-index.mjs` | Rewrites `index.json` from `package.json` and the current commit. |
| `README.zh.md` | This page in Chinese. |
| `CONTRIBUTING.md` | How to change the page and what a release must not skip. |
| `CHANGELOG.md` | User-visible versions. |
| `AGENTS.md` | The release steps and the gotchas that otherwise cost an afternoon. |

dsh-mermaid-panel README · How to reach it：The page type contributes one guide capsule, the same door `ui-sidebar-terminal` uses. Open the right Sidebar and pick **Mermaid** on the guide page. If the Sidebar has exactly one door registered — ours, when no other type offers a guide capsule — the Sidebar seeds that page as its first tab instead of the guide; that seeding rule belongs to the Sidebar, not to this plugin.

dsh-mermaid-panel README · Limits：- The page reads the DOM of the conversation that is on screen. If the chat's code-card markup changes, the page shows its empty state until the selectors are updated.
- Sources are read from what the chat has mounted, so history the chat has not rendered yet (virtualized or collapsed) is not included.
- An open page observes the document to notice a remounted conversation, so a streaming turn costs one debounced scan every ~240 ms.
- The engine is a 3.5 MB chunk, downloaded once per page load on first diagram.
- The full-screen view holds the zoom it opened with. A diagram that changes while the view is open updates in place, and that zoom stays where it was.
